target_problem: combine affine-hull rank and functional graph compression by a deterministic rule that keeps all affine basis variables as functional roots
conditional_implication: The canonical affine-first preprocessing greedily builds a rank-R basis of canonical affine-hull output blocks, protects all variables used by those equations, and then greedily selects f canonical functional anchors with unprotected distinct heads while preserving acyclicity. Because protected variables remain roots, the relaxed domain has exactly 2^(n-R-f) assignments. At most R affine outputs and f functional outputs are consumed, so m>n leaves more than eta_AF=n-R-f residual outputs. This yields deterministic O(2^eta_AF poly(N)) avoidance with eta_AF computable in polynomial time.
frontier_reason: The explicit connected exact-stretch family is handled automatically with eta_AF=3 while V97 lambda=8k, V101 mu=k+3, V102 beta=Theta(k) with beta>=3k, and V103 nu=4k+1. No supplied certificate is required.

bridge_lemmas.name: a greedy canonical affine-hull block basis has at most R selected outputs and polynomially computable rank R
protecting every variable occurring in retained affine rows keeps all rank-R equations supported on the final functional roots
greedy unprotected distinct-head functional anchors can be selected with polynomial-time cycle tests
the protected rank-R root system below f functional heads leaves exactly 2^(n-R-f) relaxed assignments
m>n leaves more than eta_AF=n-R-f residual output coordinates
the explicit 0x1e plus 0x16 family is mapped canonically to R=4k-1, f=4k-2, eta_AF=3
the same family has lambda=8k, mu=k+3, beta>=3k, and nu=4k+1
eta_AF is sublinear on every NC0_3 circuit

closed_route: requiring an externally supplied optimal hybrid certificate before functional and affine relaxations can be combined
surviving_route: analyze the worst-case size of the canonical eta_AF parameter, improve the affine-first ordering rule, or construct an explicit high-eta_AF obstruction family and isolate a new invariant
current_gap: The canonical parameter eta_AF(C) is polynomially computable but can still be linear; V104 does not prove a worst-case sublinear bound or improve the unrestricted published exponent.
stop_rule: Do not promote V105 for another ordering heuristic without a theorem. Require a worst-case bound, a strict infinite-family separation from eta_AF, an approximation/optimization theorem for hybrid selection, or a scalable high-eta_AF obstruction with a justified new route.
external_validation_target: prior-art review of affine-first protected-variable decompositions combining linear rank and functional dependencies in range avoidance, algebraic CSPs, backdoors, proof-complexity generators, and remote-point constructions
